```artifact
Feature: Administrators Menu Screen to Maintain Doctors and Chemists/Labs

  Scenario: Administrators Menu Screen to Maintain Doctors
    Given the Administrators Menu Screen is displayed
    When the user clicks on the "Maintain Doctors" button
    Then the "Add Doctor" screen is displayed

  Scenario: Add Doctor Screen
    Given the "Add Doctor" screen is displayed
    When the user enters the following details:
      | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
      | as specified | 30 | Male | as specified | 10 |
    Then a new doctor record is created with the following details:
      | Doctor Id | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
      | generated | as specified | 30 | Male | as specified | 10 |

  Scenario: Edit/Update Doctor Screen
    Given the "Edit/Update Doctor" screen is displayed
    When the user enters the following details:
      | Doctor Id | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
      | generated | as specified | 31 | Female | as specified | 11 |
    Then the doctor record is updated with the following details:
      | Doctor Id | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
      | generated | as specified | 31 | Female | as specified | 11 |

  Scenario: Delete Doctor Screen
    Given the "Delete Doctor" screen is displayed
    When the user enters the following details:
      | Doctor Id | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
      | generated | as specified | 32 | Male | as specified | 12 |
    Then an error message "Doctor has open Consultation Requests - cannot delete" is displayed

  Scenario: Administrators Menu Screen to Maintain Chemists/Labs
    Given the Administrators Menu Screen is displayed
    When the user clicks on the "Maintain Chemists/Labs" button
    Then the "Add Chemist/Lab" screen is displayed

  Scenario: Add Chemist/Lab Screen
    Given the "Add Chemist/Lab" screen is displayed
    When the user enters the following details:
      | Chemist/Lab Flag | Chemist Lab Name | Chemist Lab Address | Chemist Lab Contact Details |
      | as specified | as specified | as specified | as specified |
    Then a new chemist/lab record is created with the following details:
      | Chemist/Lab Id | Chemist/Lab Flag | Chemist Lab Name | Chemist Lab Address | Chemist Lab Contact Details |
      | generated | as specified | as specified | as specified | as specified |

  Scenario: Speciality does not exist
    Given the Speciality with Speciality Id does not exist
    When the user searches for the Speciality
    Then an error message "Speciality does not exist" is displayed

  Scenario: Doctor does not exist
    Given the Doctor with Doctor Id does not exist
    When the user searches for the Doctor
    Then an error message "Doctor does not exist" is displayed

  Scenario Outline: Add Doctor Screen with edge and invalid values
    Given the "Add Doctor" screen is displayed
    When the user enters the following details:
      | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
      | as specified | 0 | Male | as specified | 0 |
    Then an error message "Age cannot be 0" is displayed

    Examples:
      | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
      | as specified | 100 | Male | as specified | 100 |
      | as specified | 30 | Female | as specified | 10 |
      | as specified | 30 | Male | as specified | 0 |
      | as specified | 30 | Male | as specified | 100 |

  Scenario Outline: Edit/Update Doctor Screen with edge and invalid values
    Given the "Edit/Update Doctor" screen is displayed
    When the user enters the following details:
      | Doctor Id | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
      | generated | as specified | 0 | Male | as specified | 0 |
    Then an error message "Age cannot be 0" is displayed

    Examples:
      | Doctor Id | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
      | generated | as specified | 100 | Male | as specified | 100 |
      | generated | as specified | 30 | Female | as specified | 10 |
      | generated | as specified | 30 | Male | as specified | 0 |
      | generated | as specified | 30 | Male | as specified | 100 |

  Scenario Outline: Add Chemist/Lab Screen with edge and invalid values
    Given the "Add Chemist/Lab" screen is displayed
    When the user enters the following details:
      | Chemist/Lab Flag | Chemist Lab Name | Chemist Lab Address | Chemist Lab Contact Details |
      | as specified | as specified | as specified | as specified |
    Then an error message "Chemist Lab Contact Details cannot be as specified" is displayed

    Examples:
      | Chemist/Lab Flag | Chemist Lab Name | Chemist Lab Address | Chemist Lab Contact Details |
      | as specified | as specified | as specified | as specified |
      | as specified | as specified | as specified | as specified |
      | as specified | as specified | as specified | as specified |
      | as specified | as specified | as specified | as specified |
```
